edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25 from the volume identity as republished at CCEL and mirrored at New Advent, which attributes its First Clement text to Keith and its Origen commentary text to Patrick in this volume. Origen's Commentary on Matthew survives only in part in Greek and in a separate Latin series; this volume prints the surviving Greek books in translation. No exact artifact has been registered; publications consulting web transcriptions of this edition record their own access routes and limits locally.
edition.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume IX: Recently Discovered Additions to Early Christian Literature; Commentaries of Origen

alternate_titles: Recently Discovered Additions to Early Christian Literature; Commentaries of Origen
work.author: Allan Menzies
work.description: The ninth volume of the American Ante-Nicene Fathers series, edited by Allan Menzies as a supplement to the original eight, containing recently recovered early Christian texts, John Keith's translation of the Clementine epistles, and John Patrick's translation of Origen's commentaries on Matthew and John. Its container identity remains distinct from the works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: The Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume IX
